title: Thesis lines
terms: Read the metrics behind your lines for {assets}
prompt:
This is a scheduled check, and the user is not present. For each followed asset they wrote lines for (what
would change their mind), they asked you to read where each line stands.

Read each asset's page for its lines. For each line, read its metric from an original source: a filing, a
data result, or a calculation over one. Record the reading with thesis_update and its lineReading, citing
that source; the app decides whether a line was crossed and tells the user itself. Do not judge a line from
a headline, and do not record a reading you could not find in an original. Name each line you could not
read and why.

When this run has no previous_run record it is the first: report each line with its reading and date. On
later runs, report only a reading that moved materially toward or past its line since the previous run; if
you read every line and none did, call schedule_quiet. Answer in {language}.
